question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
WITH monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(CAST(payment_date as TEXT), 1, 7) as payment_month,
        SUM(amount) as monthly_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(CAST(payment_date as TEXT), 1, 7)
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_amount,
        LAG(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_monthly_amount,
        monthly_amount - LAG(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as monthly_change
    FROM monthly_payments
),
customer_avg_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        AVG(monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
    FROM monthly_changes
    WHERE monthly_change IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as full_name,
    ac.avg_monthly_change
FROM customer_avg_changes ac
JOIN customer c ON ac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ac.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 5
